title: Letter to the Church in Clay County, Missouri, 22 January 1834
source_note: JS, Sidney Rigdon, and Frederick G. Williams, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to “brethren in Christ Jesus scattered abroad,” Clay Co., MO, 22 Jan. 1834. Retained copy, [ca. 22 Jan. 1834], in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 79–81; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams; JS Collection, CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
